DSH-Right-Sidebar is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DSH Web right-side output dock that collects session artifacts, previews user-facing files, and preserves tab state per session.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-813e8bf43ad03432aa77.html
